# Recorded on an Apple M4 Mac mini (16 GB, macOS 26.4.1) on 2026-10-23 with sysctl(8),
# vm_stat(1), ulimit -l and pmset -g ps, which read the same sysctlbyname,
# host_statistics64 and IOKit power-source interfaces E1 calls. Format: src/macos/record.rs.
# vm free_count is vm_stat's "Pages free" plus "Pages speculative"; vm_stat prints
# free_count - speculative_count as "Pages free".
sysctl hw.optional.arm64 u32 1
sysctl machdep.cpu.brand_string str Apple M4
sysctl hw.optional.arm.AdvSIMD u32 1
sysctl hw.optional.arm.FEAT_DotProd u32 1
sysctl hw.optional.arm.FEAT_FP16 u32 1
sysctl hw.optional.arm.FEAT_I8MM u32 1
sysctl hw.optional.arm.FEAT_BF16 u32 1
sysctl hw.optional.arm.FEAT_SVE2 absent
sysctl hw.optional.arm.FEAT_SME2 u32 1
sysctl hw.nperflevels u32 2
sysctl hw.perflevel0.physicalcpu u32 4
sysctl hw.perflevel0.l3cachesize absent
sysctl hw.perflevel0.l2cachesize u32 16777216
sysctl hw.perflevel0.cpusperl2 u32 4
sysctl hw.perflevel1.physicalcpu u32 6
sysctl hw.perflevel1.l3cachesize absent
sysctl hw.perflevel1.l2cachesize u32 4194304
sysctl hw.perflevel1.cpusperl2 u32 6
sysctl hw.physicalcpu u32 10
sysctl hw.logicalcpu u32 10
sysctl hw.memsize u64 17179869184
sysctl iogpu.wired_limit_mb u32 0
sysctl kern.osrelease str 25.4.0
sysctl kern.osproductversion str 26.4.1
vm page_size=16384 free=28015 active=340750 inactive=319984 wired=115138 purgeable=1476 speculative=22556 compressor=210161
memlock unlimited
power providing AC Power
